usedFor: Google Books keeps a reader's shelves, and “Add Volume to Bookshelf” files a specific volume on a shelf you pick.

bestTemplate.name: “Add Volume to Bookshelf” in Google Books
bestTemplate.why: It puts a specific volume on a selected bookshelf, so a reading list stays up to date without manual work.

watchOut: “Add Volume to Bookshelf” in Google Books needs a specific volume and a selected bookshelf, so pass both.
